$comment: Whether the platform's estate runs STANDING BUILD HOSTS (Doc/Architecture/BuildHosts; MeshWeaver.Plugins Hosting/StandingBuildHosts), and which channels core's CD rolls onto the set it arms (`main-cd.yml` job `build-host-latest`, `build-host-announcement.py`). The hosts live on the operations record `.github/control-instance.json` names. While `enabled` is false the CD job sends NOTHING; the receiver guards the same fact again (it changes a record only when that record's `buildHosts.enabled` is true). Turning it on is two acts in this order: the record's `buildHosts` block (through its approval path), then `enabled: true` here.
